title: ConfGuard: a physics-grounded reference monitor for predictive-maintenance large-language-model agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-language-model agents now close the industrial predictive-maintenance loop, reading sensor windows, retrieving procedures and dispatching work orders. Two attack channels meet there: injected text in a retrieved document can hijack the decision, and a bounded sensor perturbation can corrupt the remaining-useful-life estimate behind it. Recent agent defenses police data provenance and tool privilege but cannot tell whether a prognostic quantity is physically plausible. ConfGuard is a reference monitor with a physics-grounded policy. Its conformal monitor tests each prediction, anchored to the asset's admitted history, against degradation physics: capped remaining life never rises and falls at most one cycle per cycle. Calibrating its threshold over whole asset trajectories lets the operator set the expected share of a clean asset's windows the running monitor escalates. A physics-policy validator checks the agent's maintenance-urgen

translated_title: ConfGuard：面向预测性维护大语言模型智能体的基于物理规律的参考监视器
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体如今已能闭环工业预测性维护流程：读取传感器数据窗口、检索维护规程并派发工单。此处存在两条攻击通道：检索文档中被注入的文本可能劫持智能体的决策，而有界的传感器扰动可能破坏其背后的剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计。近期的智能体防御手段只管控数据来源和工具权限，却无法判断预测量在物理上是否合理。ConfGuard 是一个采用基于物理策略的参考监视器。其保形监视器以资产已确认的历史记录为锚点，依据退化物理规律检验每一项预测：被封顶的剩余寿命绝不会上升，且每个周期至多下降一个周期。通过在完整的资产轨迹上校准阈值，操作员可以设定运行中的监视器对健康资产数据窗口触发升级告警的预期比例。一个物理策略验证器负责检查智能体的维护紧急性判断（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: ConfGuard 提出了一种基于退化物理规律的参考监视器，通过保形预测校验预测性维护 LLM 智能体的剩余寿命预测是否符合物理约束（寿命不上升且每周期至多降一周期），从而抵御文档注入攻击和传感器扰动。
en_tdlr: ConfGuard introduces a physics-grounded reference monitor that uses conformal prediction to check whether LLM agents' remaining-useful-life predictions obey degradation physics (life never rises and falls at most one cycle per cycle), defending predictive-maintenance agents against injected text and bounded sensor perturbations.
